stories.headline: Citi Plans to Acquire Kard to Deliver More Personalized Rewards
stories.body: Citi’s U.S. Consumer Cards business plans to expand its customer engagement and commerce media capabilities by acquiring Kard Financial, a commerce media and rewards platform for banks and FinTechs, Citi said in a Thursday (Aug. 13) press release. stories.headline: New York puts bank boards on the hook for vendor tech
stories.body: Many banks can't say what software their IT provider runs. Only 58% of community and midsize banks even hold the right to audit that vendor, a survey found.
